answer: One concrete mechanism: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because sonnet only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, willow is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
